entities.summary: Eugene Morrison Stoner was an American machinist and firearms designer who is most associated with the development of the ArmaLite AR-15 rifle that was redesigned and modified by Colt's Patent Firearm Company for the United States military as the M16 rifle. Eugene Stoner was a performers & entertainers from Gosport (1922-11-22, Gosport–1997-04-24). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
